output.fix: The assertion validates, so nothing is broken. The long validity window is a security risk but not a failure. A window this long widens the replay surface. Ask the IdP admin to cut the assertion lifetime (NotOnOrAfter minus NotBefore) to about 5 to 10 minutes. Session length is a separate setting on the SP side, so this doesn't shorten user sessions. If you see "not yet valid" errors, fix clock drift with NTP. Don't widen the window or raise clock skew above 5 minutes. Also keep one-time-use tracking of assertion IDs on the SP, so a replay inside the window is rejected.
